title: The Lord's Going-Forth, One Beside Another
description: The Lord's pattern of approach to the soul in withdrawal. T25 — the Lord's outgoing in five, called forth from his five faculties one beside another: from his mind the Beloved of Lights, from his thought the Mother of Life, from his teaching the Beloved, from his counsel the Virgin of Light, from his reflection the fifth. T26 — three likenesses of the Lord going forth to gather what he loves: as Divine Human seeking his own and shining over the two scattered, as Operative Power forging armament in a great furnace and lifting the king's son out of his enemies' hand, as Summoning Call entering the very country where she had been held to make manifest there that she was never the property of what claimed her.
